screen.title: Announcement: Library hours
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement in the library.

audio.text: Hello, students. The library will be open late this week for exams. It will close at midnight instead of ten. Group study rooms can be booked online for two hours at a time. Please keep your voices down on the quiet floors.

questions.stem: Why will the library stay open late?
How can students reserve a study room?
